LEADY SQUID - RetroStone VC (Windows build)
All rights reserved, 8BCraft (Pierre-Louis Boyer). Preview build with placeholder art and sound.

Run LeadySquid.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

A squid with too many lead diving weights: every press is a jet of water.
Swim through the gaps, one point per obstacle. Shell medals at 10, 20, 30, 40.

Keyboard                          Gamepad (SNES layout)
  Z, X, Up, Enter ... swim (flap)   A, B, X, Y, Up, Start
  Backspace, Esc .... pause         Select
  F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen    F12: screenshot    close the window to quit

Two players (race): press a button on a second gamepad on the title or
"get ready" screen.

Options: LeadySquid.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in leadysquid.srm next to the exe.
